facts.name: Swamp Milkweed
facts.notes: A clump-forming milkweed for moist spots, with fragrant pink flowers. A monarch host plant that does not run like common milkweed.

sources.title: Michigan Wildflower Farm: Wetland species list

companions.why: Combines well with great blue lobelia, irises and marsh milkweed; also found with purple coneflower, blazing star and foxglove beardtongue.

sources.title: Wisconsin Horticulture (UW–Madison Extension): Cardinal Flower article

companions.why: Minnesota Board of Water and Soil Resources: pairs well with other moist prairie plants, including rattlesnake master and swamp milkweed.

sources.title: Minnesota Board of Water and Soil Resources: featured plant, Mountain Mint

companions.why: New Moon Nurseries: try pairing with swamp milkweed, turtlehead, Joe-Pye weed (Eupatorium purpureum) or great blue lobelia.
